As we age, balance can become more challenging, increasing the risk of slips and falls. Discover three simple, effective exercises to help improve stability, build confidence, and keep you moving safely and independently after 60.
Brad Heineck, the late Bob Schrupp, and their team created the most famous physical therapy channel, helping millions stay healthy, fit, and pain-free. Bob’s mission lives on through his children and the Bob & Brad team.
